races.keyFactor: Highest-ranking House toady in a Biden district (96.1% score). Overwhelmingly punished by Hudson Valley suburbanites for lockstep votes.
races.name: Michael Lawler

races.keyFactor: Ranked #4 Toady in Congress (96.3% score) in a wealthy, college-educated suburban district. Voters rejected national MAGA agenda.
races.name: Thomas H. Kean, Jr.

races.keyFactor: Previously cast as an independent moderate, Bacon's 95.1% loyalty score destroyed his crossover appeal in suburban Omaha.
races.name: Don Bacon

races.keyFactor: Ranked #6 Toady (96.0% score). Relentless combative rhetoric and loyalty to Trump tariffs turned dairy farmers and rural swing voters.
races.name: Derrick Van Orden

races.keyFactor: 95.0% Trump loyalty in Des Moines suburbs proved fatal amid higher-than-expected suburban Democratic mobilization.
races.name: Zachary Nunn

races.keyFactor: Navy veteran Kiggans (94.5% score) suffered from federal employee and veteran backlash to Trump administration executive firings.
races.name: Jennifer A. Kiggans

races.keyFactor: Despite surviving past cycles as a moderate, Valadao's 93.4% alignment in a heavily Latino Central Valley seat drove record turnout against him.
races.name: David G. Valadao

races.keyFactor: Suffolk County voters flipped after LaLota's 95.1% score alienating moderate eastern Long Island commuters.
races.name: Nick LaLota

races.keyFactor: Freshman Hurd (95.1% score) could not replicate conservative margins on the Western Slope as water and public lands issues dominated.
races.name: Jeff Hurd

races.keyFactor: Longtime Freedom Caucus chair and Trump confidant (84.5% score) ousted following heavy voter revolt in Dauphin and Cumberland counties.
races.name: Scott Perry

races.keyFactor: 93.3% loyalty score dragged down James in Macomb County auto-worker communities concerned about trade instability.
races.name: John James

races.keyFactor: Calvert (93.4% score, 30+ years in Congress) finally lost Palm Springs/Corona battleground to Rollins in repeat rematch.
races.name: Ken Calvert

races.keyFactor: The lowest-scoring Republican in PA (78.6%). By frequently voting against Trump nominees and hardline bills, Fitzpatrick preserved his swing-district coalition.
races.name: Brian K. Fitzpatrick

races.keyFactor: Rank #7 Toady (95.6% score) survived Columbus suburbs by the narrowest margin of his career, saved only by rural southern turnout.
races.name: Mike Carey

races.keyFactor: Rank #2 Toady in House (96.7% score). In deeply conservative northeastern Ohio, total Trump fealty remains an electoral asset, not a liability.
races.name: Max L. Miller

races.keyFactor: #1 Ranked Toady in the House (97.5% score). Survived primary challenges from the far-right and held off Democratic challenger on border issues.
races.name: Tony Gonzales

races.keyFactor: Having carpetbagged to the ultra-safe CO-04, Boebert's 88.1% loyalty score easily carried her across the eastern plains.
races.name: Lauren Boebert

races.keyFactor: Top Crossover Democrat (71.3% score). By backing Trump on border enforcement and deregulation, Perez retained working-class southwest WA.
races.name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez

races.keyFactor: 69.7% loyalty score. Golden proved once again that calculated crossover votes insulate Democrats in rural Trump-voting districts.
races.name: Jared F. Golden

races.keyFactor: 78.7% loyalty score. Retained south Texas Rio Grande Valley seat by embracing bipartisan border policies.
races.name: Henry Cuellar

races.keyFactor: 76.9% loyalty score. Former Gov. Roy Cooper mobilized suburban Research Triangle and Charlotte to capture North Carolina's Senate seat.
races.name: Thom Tillis

races.keyFactor: 80.0% score (Rank #49). Collins could no longer sustain her centrist brand after voting to confirm controversial Trump judicial and cabinet appointees.
races.name: Susan M. Collins

races.keyFactor: Low loyalty score (20.3%). Energized Atlanta suburban coalition and young voters to secure a second term in Georgia.
races.name: Jon Ossoff

races.keyFactor: Low loyalty score (23.6%). Strong union backing and pragmatic constituent service propelled Peters to re-election in Michigan.
races.name: Gary C. Peters
